plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for CERN White Rabbit Switches (WRS; enterprise PEN 96, WR-SWITCH-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports memory utilization and size, 1/5-minute CPU load averages, FPGA / PLL / power-supply temperatures and the main system status.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the CERN White Rabbit Switch in percent, from WR-SWITCH-MIB wrsMemoryUsedPerc (1.3.6.1.4.1.96.100.7.1.4.3). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the CERN White Rabbit Switch in bytes, from WR-SWITCH-MIB wrsMemoryTotal (1.3.6.1.4.1.96.100.7.1.4.1, kilobytes) multiplied by 1024 in the collector. Values less than or equal to 0 are dropped.

metrics.name: cern_wrs_cpu_load_1min
metrics.description: 1-minute Linux CPU load average of the CERN White Rabbit Switch, from WR-SWITCH-MIB wrsCPULoadAvg1min (1.3.6.1.4.1.96.100.7.1.5.1, load times 100) divided by 100 in the collector. Negative values are dropped. This is a load average, not a CPU percentage.

metrics.name: cern_wrs_cpu_load_5min
metrics.description: 5-minute Linux CPU load average of the CERN White Rabbit Switch, from WR-SWITCH-MIB wrsCPULoadAvg5min (1.3.6.1.4.1.96.100.7.1.5.2, load times 100) divided by 100 in the collector. Negative values are dropped. This is a load average, not a CPU percentage.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Per-sensor temperature of the CERN White Rabbit Switch in degrees Celsius, from WR-SWITCH-MIB wrsTempFPGA / wrsTempPLL / wrsTempPSL / wrsTempPSR (1.3.6.1.4.1.96.100.7.1.3.1-4), tagged as sensor_name fpga / pll / psl / psr. Values outside -40 to 125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: cern_wrs_system_status
metrics.description: Main system status of the CERN White Rabbit Switch from WR-SWITCH-MIB wrsMainSystemStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.96.100.6.1.1). ok(1) maps to 1 (normal); na(0), error(2), warning(3), warningNA(4) and bug(5) map to 2 (abnormal). Values outside 0-5 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
